headline: European AI cloud company Verda, formerly called DataCrunch, raised $189 million in a funding round led by Emergence Capital.
score_reason: Lowered from 5 to 3: the round was announced on 22 Sep 2026, two weeks before the window, and the later item appears to repeat it.
importance_line: What changed is little, since the round was announced on 22 Sep 2026, which matters mainly to the companies that rent AI computing power from Verda in Europe, then to the investors in the round, then to rival cloud providers, and the doubt is that the figures come from the company's own announcement.
summary: SiliconANGLE reported on 22 Sep 2026 that Verda Cloud Oy, a Helsinki company that rents out AI computing power, raised $189 million in a Series B round (an early-stage funding round) led by Emergence Capital, bringing its total raised in equity and debt to more than $450 million. The round was announced on 22 Sep 2026, two weeks before Data Center Dynamics reported it again on 5 Oct 2026.
notes: OLDER NEWS RE-DATED: announced 22 Sep 2026 (SiliconANGLE; Bloomberg also reported it on 22 Sep 2026). The Data Center Dynamics page (the pool item, dated 5 Oct 2026 in the pool) could not be opened (HTTP 403), so it was not checked for newer facts; SiliconANGLE's text was read instead.
